title: Soft Body Avocado Juggling Arena
description: A ReadyPlayer.me avatar stands in a small arena surrounded by soft-body avocados that deform on impact. The user launches avocados toward the avatar using click-and-drag, adjusting force and angle, while the avocados squish, bounce, and settle with spring-mass soft-body simulation. The goal is to stack six deformed avocados on a target platform near the avatar.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a soft-body avocado juggling and stacking scene. Load the ReadyPlayer.me avatar from shared_assets/readyplayer.me.glb and place it at the center of a circular ground platform (radius 5, subtle grid texture). Load the Avocado from shared_assets/Avocado.glb and clone it to create a pool of 8 avocado instances, initially placed on a shelf to the left. Each avocado must have a soft-body simulation: represent each avocado mesh with 12-16 spring-connected vertex clusters that deform on collision. On impact with the ground or platform, vertices compress inward proportional to impact velocity, then spring back with damping factor 0.85 and stiffness 0.4. Use Verlet integration for position updates each frame. Add a raised target platform (1.5 x 1.5 x 0.3) to the right of the avatar. The user interaction flow: (1) click an avocado on the shelf to select it (highlight with emissive glow), (2) click-and-drag on the scene to set launch direction and power shown by an arrow helper, (3) release to launch the avocado in a parabolic arc with gravity -9.8, (4) avocado deforms on landing via the soft-body system, (5) if it lands on the target platform it sticks with friction, (6) repeat until 6 avocados are stacked, then display a congratulations overlay. Validate each step: selection must occur before drag, power must be between 5-25 units, launch angle must be between 10-80 degrees. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 6, 12) with OrbitControls. Add ambient light intensity 0.6, a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with shadows enabled, and a hemisphere light for fill. Render soft-body deformation every frame by updating geometry vertex positions and recomputing normals. Show a small UI panel counting successfully stacked avocados out of 6.
